packMeta.name: Curated Snooker Routine Library v2
packMeta.author: Snooker Practice PWA
packMeta.description: Modernized curated snooker training library aligned to the v5.7 routine DB model with setup cards, benchmark ladders, normalized skill maps, scoring rules, and Club-default/Senior-stretch import targets.
packMeta.recommendedUse: Import selected routines, using Club target by default and Senior as stretch. Adjust import target level in the preview if needed.

routines.name: Straight red potting ladder
routines.description: 20 straight red pots from progressive distances; reset after each shot. Purpose: Build repeatable technical execution and improve transfer into realistic frame situations.
routines.setupDescription: 20 straight red pots from progressive distances; reset after each shot.
routines.benchmarkSource: Curated Library v2 benchmark calibration; aligned with Nolan-style Junior / Club / Senior / Pro ladders
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 35, Club: 45, Senior: 55, Pro: 85. Default import target is Club; stretch target is Senior.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record successful executions out of 20 attempts. A success must meet the full pot/control objective, not only contact.
routines.coachingPurpose: Build repeatable technical execution and improve transfer into realistic frame situations.
routines.commonMistake: Judging the drill by pots only while ignoring delivery quality and repeatability.
